messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from yesterday's PM — we still have 3 remediation items with no clear owners or timelines. want to lock owners + JIRA today so they don't float into next sprint.

jay: which ones are unowned right now?

marta: short list: 1) hotfix rollback automation (recurring latency spikes when prefix eviction hits) 2) alert tuning for batch queueing (too many noisy pages) 3) postmortem doc + runbook updates (make rollback steps explicit).

sam: I can own alert tuning (2). will open a ticket and baseline current FPR/TPR.

kevin: I can own the rollback automation (1) but will need eng-runtime pairing — @anya for review/QA?

anya: happy to review + update runbook once rollback design is sketched. can own (3) if someone opens the doc ticket.

marta: cool. proposed RACI for each:
- rollback automation: R=kevin, A=marta, C=anya, I=oncall
- alert tuning: R=sam, A=jay, C=eng-sre, I=marta
- runbook/docs: R=anya, A=marta, C=oncall, I=jay

sam: creating ticket INF-3970 for alert tuning now (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3970). ETA: initial PR by 2026-03-30.

oncall-bot: Created INF-3970 (Alert tuning for batch queueing) and assigned to sam.

kevin: created draft design branch for rollback automation. will file INF-3972 for the infra work and link runtime pairing request. ETA: spike + PR by 2026-04-06.

anya: opening INF-3971 for runbook + doc updates. will merge checklist and runbook by 2026-04-02.

jay: I'll add INF-3970/71/72 to the remediation tracker and pin them to the postmortem board. sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/REM-TRACKER

marta: thanks — two follow-ups: 1) flag any cross-team blockers by Fri EOD so we can escalate to platform leads; 2) who is backup owner if primary is oncall or OOO during implementation?

sam: backup for alert tuning: jay (if I'm oncall).

kevin: backup for rollback automation: anya.

anya: backup for runbook: marta.

marta: great. also note recurring pattern: this kind of latency spike has shown up 3x in last 10 weeks under high-concurrency tests. please add short notes to the ticket about recurrence (cause hypothesis: prefix eviction thrash under mixed batch sizes).

kevin: will add load test traces + timeline to INF-3972.

sam: will attach alert history + sample noisy traces to INF-3970.

jay: for tracking cadence, propose a 15-min sync on Mon morning next week to confirm progress. ok?

marta: yes — put it on calendar. final ask: owners, please set the JIRA "remediation ETA" field and link PRs to the postmortem doc. once done reply here with ticket numbers and ETA. :thumbsup:

sam: INF-3970 — ETA 2026-03-30.

anya: INF-3971 — ETA 2026-04-02.

kevin: INF-3972 — ETA 2026-04-06.

marta: perfect. leaving this thread open until all three are closed. will ping again if any blocker pops up. :white_check_mark:
